title: Pure Snake-Eye
summary: Snake-Eye cards only, with generic staples; the page's Diabellstar the Black Witch and WANTED line belongs to the Diabellstar list, and Original Sinful Spoils - Snake-Eye is Forbidden in the TCG. Snake-Eye Ash searches a Level 1 FIRE monster, and each small Snake-Eye sends two face-up cards to the GY to summon the next from the Deck. Snake-Eyes Poplar summons itself whenever it is added to the hand and searches a Snake-Eye Spell/Trap. The deck parks monsters, its own and the opponent's, in the Spell & Trap Zone as Continuous Spells and pulls them back out on the opponent's turn. The 2025 Dragons lead the Extra Deck: Snake-Eyes Doomed Dragon is summoned by sending two of those Monster Cards from the Spell & Trap Zone, and Snake-Eyes Vengeance Dragon parks a monster on either player's Main Phase. Promethean Princess, Bestower of Flames is the generic FIRE Link that revives the Snake-Eyes.
main: Snake-Eye Ash
Starter: searches a Level 1 FIRE; sends two cards to summon a Snake-Eye from the Deck.
Snake-Eyes Poplar
Summons itself when added to the hand; searches a Snake-Eye Spell/Trap.
Snake-Eye Oak
Recovers or revives a Level 1 FIRE; sends two cards to summon a Snake-Eye.
Snake-Eye Birch
Summons itself next to a FIRE; summons a Snake-Eye on their turn.
Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon
Parks a monster as a Continuous Spell; revives two Level 1 FIREs when it leaves.
Snake-Eyes Diabellstar
Parks itself and an attacker; comes back by parking a FIRE.
Divine Temple of the Snake-Eye
Field Spell: parks a Snake-Eye, then summons it when they summon.
Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye
Parks any face-up monster as a Continuous Spell.
Dramatic Snake-Eye Chase
Quick-Play: parks Snake-Eyes Diabellstar from the Deck.
Startling Stare of the Snake-Eyes
Parks one of their monsters, or summons a parked one to your field.
